summary: The note surveys time capsule discoveries that preserved architectural blueprints, sketches and models, from an 1885 capsule in Middletown to a new capsule erected in Harborview in 2024. It covers preservation methods, comparisons between past designs and present sustainable and modular trends, educational uses, and the social values the plans reflect. It closes by suggesting these finds show a cyclical pattern in architectural ideals and inspire future design.
one_line: Time capsules containing blueprints and models reveal past architectural visions, preservation techniques, and cyclical trends that may shape future local architecture.
key_facts: On September 5, 2023, a time capsule from 1885 was found beneath the cornerstone of the Old Court House in Middletown, planned and sealed by architect Edwin Forsythe.
The Middletown capsule held sketches, blueprints and miniature models for public spaces, commercial façades and residential homes reflecting the era's industrial optimism.
On December 17, 2023, a capsule made by local engineer Marianne Houghton was discovered in the village of Eddington.
Houghton's capsule used a hermetically sealed copper box lined with a then-modern polymer to protect against moisture and pests.
Houghton's capsule held blueprints for a civic center incorporating sustainable technologies far ahead of her time.
On February 8, 2024, blueprints for the town's first suspension bridge by Dr. Jonas Clarke, a 1930s innovation, were found at the renovation site of the historic Baymont Library.
Clarke's blueprints carried his own annotations and personal notes, and such finds are being integrated into local history and architecture school curriculums.
On March 10, 2024, a capsule in Old Wickfield revealed 1950s plans for a city center with modular buildings designed for adaptability, reflecting post-war optimism.

On June 30, 2024, a capsule in New Haven contained a late 20th-century master plan for a utopian project with green spaces, pedestrian-friendly zones and communal living, contrasting with suburban sprawl.
On August 15, 2024, the coastal city of Harborview erected a new time capsule marking the 200th anniversary of its foundation.
Harborview's capsule includes 3D printed models and holographic blueprints of present-day Harborview, plus plans hypothesizing the next century's advancements.
